summary: The notebook currently holds two notes: a foundational course note on gradient descent and a reading note on the Transformer paper, spanning machine-learning and deep-learning areas.

areas.label: Machine Learning
areas.coverage: One course note covers gradient descent basics: the update rule, a quadratic worked example, and learning-rate failure modes.
areas.gap: Momentum, Adam, and other refined optimizers mentioned as follow-ups are not yet covered.

areas.label: Deep Learning
areas.coverage: A structured reading note explains the Transformer's self-attention design, multi-head attention, and WMT 2014 results.
areas.gap: Downstream topics flagged as improvements—sub-quadratic attention, positional encoding variants, training-stability recipes—have no dedicated notes yet.
